summary: A missed CI objective opens one operational fault for the fleet fault agent, which ends when the objective is met again

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers and no wire format. The faults are existing operational.failure and operational.recovered claims with only their existing fields.

rules.detail: Claim kinds, fields, rules, permissions and digests are unchanged. The failure's reviewer is the fleet fault agent, an agent, never a person.

compatibility.detail: On the member whose repository observer reads Workspace CI, each minute's SLO sample opens an operational.failure (condition slo-objective-missed, severity warning) on daemon/NODE for each missed CI objective (merge-latency/p50, merge-latency/p95, ci-critical-path/p95, flakes) that has no open fault, in the episode slo-objective/NODE/ID, and ends it with operational.recovered when the objective's row is met again. The fleet fault agent receives each as a normal-priority fault. With no fault agent, nothing opens. Rows with no data neither open nor end one; other objectives open none.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback stops opening and ending these faults; any fault left open stays visible to the fault agent until it is resolved by hand.
